title: F--A34 STOCKPILE REMOVAL
description: SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS FOR A34 Stockpile Removal  The Bureau of Reclamation, Interior Region 8: Lower Colorado Basin (LCB), Yuma Area Office (YAO), is seeking sources to collect, haul, and dispose of all material from the designated stockpile, which includes asbestos cement pipe (ACP), to an appropriate waste facility. Contractor will provide certified personnel to verify complete ACP removal at the site.   THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS, QUOTE, OR AN INVITATION FOR BIDS and does not constitute any commitment by the Government. No formal solicitation for this work exists at this time. All qualified concerns may submit capability statements for consideration. Capability statements received will be reviewed to determine the technical, administrative, and management capability of such offerors to perform this type of work. The capability statements will be used to determine the appropriate procurement strategy whether a set-aside or an alternate procurement strategy is warranted. The Government does not intend to award a contract and will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. All interested sources must respond to future solicitation announcements separately from responses to the sources sought notice.   The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this project is 562910, Remediation Services, Small Business Standard Size 1,000 in number of employees. All interested parties should verify that they fall under the NAICS code as a Small Business prior to submission. Responses to this notice will be used by the Government to make the appropriate acquisition decision. Contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov).   BACKGROUND: The Bureau of Reclamation (BOR), Lower Colorado Basin, Yuma Area Office (YAO), has a requirement to remove and properly dispose of debris and materials contained within a designated stockpile area. The work includes over-excavation and disposal of the top 8 inches of soil beneath the stockpile, followed by post-removal soil sampling to verify that asbestos contamination is no longer present. If asbestos concentrations exceeding background levels are identified during verification sampling, the Contractor shall perform additional excavation and disposal only to the extent necessary to achieve acceptable levels. Protecting the health and safety of all personnel involved in the work is of paramount importance.  BOR owns property in Yuma County, Arizona, containing fragments of broken asbestos-cement pipe (ACP). The site has historically been used as a gravel stockpile yard that supports YAO water system facilities. Under this requirement, the Contractor shall collect, transport, and legally dispose of all material within the designated stockpile area, including ACP, at an approved disposal facility. The Contractor shall provide qualified and certified personnel to verify complete ACP removal and compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations. The Contractor shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment, transportation, supervision, and incidentals necessary to perform the work in a safe and satisfactory manner.   PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: The Government anticipates the term of the contract shall be 180 calendar days from the date of receipt of a Notice-of-Award.   NORMAL PERFORMANCE HOURS: Services are to be performed in accordance with the Statement Of Work (SOW) between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. (PT), Monday through Friday, holidays excluded. Contractor shall notify government representatives when accessing the site for both normal and after hours. Gate shall remain closed and locked after departure.  PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: - The abatement work required is located on BOR property along the Salinity Canal in Yuma County, AZ. Major cross streets are S Avenue 4-1/2E and E Levee Rd. Refer to the Project Location Map included in the Appendix Part C. Contractor is allowed to stage within the fenced stockpile yard and daisy chain a lock on the gate. Contractor shall: not obstruct Reclamation maintenance staff from continuing work activities within the yard.    SMALL BUSINESS CERTIFICATION WITH THE SMALL BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION (SBA): The Government is only interested in responses from small businesses that can perform the services. Please identify your federally designated small business category or categories.   The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity. Based on the responses to this Sources Sought Notice/Market Research, this requirement may be set-aside for small businesses or procured through full and open competition. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submission.   SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: All interested and qualified firms responding to this Sources Sought Notice are required to provide the following information:   1. Business Name, physical/mailing address, phone, point of contact, email and website if applicable;   2. Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) Number;   3. Firm's Capability Statement: The Capability Statements shall be no more than 5-pages in length. Please address the particulars of this effort, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability;   4. A list of similar projects within the last five (5) years (at least three (3) descriptions) *Note: The list of relevant contracts/projects shall include the location, contract number, description, and estimated yearly value, and performance dates;   5. Any or all Small Business Classifications (Tell us if you are certified with the SBA under a socio-economic program such as, but, not limited to 8(a) Program, SDVOSB, VOSB, HUBZone, Small Disadvantaged, WOSB, ISBEE)   6.
